AvailabilitySlot.title: AvailabilitySlot
AvailabilitySlot.description: Represents a single tutoring availability slot on a specific date and time slot (Lunch or After School).

date.description: Calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format (Asia/Hong_Kong time zone).

timeSlot.description: The tutoring time slot on that date.

status.description: The internal availability status of the slot.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last modification.

updatedBy.description: UID of the teacher who updated the slot.

/availability/{slotId}.description: Stores tutoring availability statuses keyed by slotId (e.g., YYYY-MM-DD_lunch or YYYY-MM-DD_after_school). Publicly readable by students, writable only by the authorized teacher.
